Clarification required

I couldn't make this plan implementation-ready, so it ends `STATUS: NOT_CLEAR`. The design is complete, but the issue body has no `files_touched:` block. That block is what grants the implementer permission to edit protected paths. Five of the files this change needs sit under `.github/` or `scripts/`. Without the grant, the implement-time guard will refuse them and latch `ai:scope-blocked`, which is what happened to #6766. The pipeline must not grant itself that permission. A trusted person has to add the block below to the issue body before `/approved`.

Implementation Plan — #6769: hold automatic `/approved` for plans that touch automation paths

Planning ref: `git rev-parse HEAD` = `984ed44077726084b66f4c938d8ff0a6fd1bfd10`, branch `main`. The planning context recorded `0b14e3db…`, but the checkout moved before planning. There is no integration-branch metadata, so the target is `main` (Q2 = A).

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends files_touched_scope_guard.py (is_automation_path / build_automation_grant / check_automation_paths)
Scope-mode justification: The operator step asks for exactly one change: a gate that is off by default and holds automatic `/approved` in three places. Those are `plan.yml`, the managed stall-recovery `auto_approve`, and the standalone stall-recovery `auto_approve` (Q3 = B: the staged-support latch release is left alone). The gate only applies to plans whose planned files include automation paths (Q1 = B). It reuses `main`'s existing path classifier and exact-grant parser. `stable` gets it through the normal promote path (Q2 = A). The complete option (`plan.yml` plus both poller paths, with tests and docs) is the minimum the answers require. Nothing is added beyond that: no backport PR, no latch-release change, no rewrite of the implement guard.

Automation / scheduling (§20.E)
- No new script. This extends existing code: `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py` gets a new CLI mode, and `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` and `.github/workflows/plan.yml` get new gate code.
- Where it runs:
  - the `plan.yml` step "Auto-approve clear plan", triggered by an `issue_comment` `/answer`;
  - `orchestrate_poll.yml`, via the `internal-orchestrate-poll.yml` cron `*/5`, in the `auto_approve` arms of `execute_stall_recovery_action` (managed) and the standalone stall recovery loop.
- No supervisor, no database work, no registry entry.

1. Files likely to change
- `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`: new plan-gate functions and a CLI mode.
- `.github/workflows/plan.yml`:
  - job env: add `AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED`;
  - add `files_touched_scope_guard.py` to the staging `for f in …` list (around line 286);
  - gate inside the "Auto-approve clear plan" step;
  - add `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` to that step's env.
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`: add `files_touched_scope_guard.py` to the staging list (around line 407), and pass `AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED: ${{ vars.AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED || 'false' }}` into the poller step env.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:
  - new gate helper;
  - call it from the managed `auto_approve` arm (around line 14678) and the standalone `auto_approve` arm (around line 18081);
  - add issue-level `author { login }` and `authorAssociation` to `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql`.
- `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py`: unit and CLI regressions.
- `tests/test_plan_auto_approve_safe_state_fetch.py`: contract for the plan.yml gate.
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`: poller regressions for both arms.
- `README.md`: new row in the Variables table.
- `agents.md`: a short note under "Implement scope-lock label".
- `changelog.d/6769-automation-path-plan-auto-approval-gate.md` (new file).
- Not changed: `implement.yml`, `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh` (the implementation guard stays as it is), the staged-support latch release (around line 17330), and `workflow-templates/` (the reusable workflows read `vars.*` directly).

Grant the issue body needs. A trusted person (OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR, or the `GH_PAT` account) must add this before implement runs:
```
files_touched:
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
- .github/workflows/plan.yml
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml
- tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py
- tests/test_plan_auto_approve_safe_state_fetch.py
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
- README.md
- agents.md
- changelog.d/6769-automation-path-plan-auto-approval-gate.md
```

2. Functions and modules
`scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`. I checked these names: none exist yet.
- `EXIT_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_HOLD = 40`. The existing codes 0, 10, 20 and 30 are unchanged.
- `extract_plan_files_section(plan_text) -> str | None`
  - Finds the "Files likely to change" or "Files to change" section. It accepts a markdown heading, a numbered line (`1. Files likely to change`) or a bold line.
  - The section ends at the next heading, the next top-level numbered item, or the next labelled section (for example "Functions", "Data structures", "API").
  - Returns `None` when there is no such section.
- `plan_automation_paths(plan_text) -> list[str]`
  - Scans the files section. If there isn't one, it scans the whole plan; that fallback is deliberately the stricter choice.
  - Picks out tokens under `.github/`, `.claude/`, `scripts/`, `prompts/` or `workflow-templates/`, any letter case, with optional backticks and an optional leading `./`.
  - Strips trailing punctuation, normalises with `normalize_path`, filters with `is_automation_path`, and deduplicates in order.
  - Negated "No changes to …" sublists are not excluded. Excluding them would mean trusting text parsing to open the gate.
- `evaluate_plan_auto_approval(plan_text, issue_meta, pipeline_login, enabled, allow_workflow_edits, issue_number) -> dict`, returning `{"decision": "allow"|"hold", "reason": str, "protected_paths": [...], "missing_paths": [...]}`:
  - No protected paths: `allow` with `reason=no_automation_paths`. This keeps today's behaviour.
  - Protected paths and the flag is off: `hold` with `reason=automation_path_plan_auto_approval_disabled`; `missing_paths` is every protected path.
  - Protected paths and the flag is on: build the grant with `build_automation_grant(issue_meta, pipeline_login)`, then call `check_automation_paths(protected_paths, grant, allow_workflow_edits, issue_number)`.
    - `granted` → `allow`.
    - Any other result → `hold`, with that function's own reason (`no_allowlist`, `untrusted_author`, `path_not_granted`, `workflow_edits_disabled`, `grant_issue_mismatch`, `identity_unavailable`, …) and its list of denied paths.
  - Globs and paths ending in `/` can never match an exact grant, so they are held (fail closed).
- CLI mode `--plan-auto-approval-gate`, with new args `--plan-file` and `--gate-enabled`. It also reuses the existing `--issue-meta-file`, `--pipeline-login`, `--allow-workflow-edits` and `--issue-number`.
  - Prints the JSON result on stdout.
  - Exits 0 for allow and 40 for hold.
  - Unreadable input, bad JSON or an exception: print a `hold` result with `reason=gate_error` and exit 40.
  - The flag counts as on only for `1`, `true`, `yes` or `on` (any case). Anything else counts as off.

`.github/workflows/plan.yml`, step "Auto-approve clear plan". The gate goes after the trust and open-state checks and inside the `AUTO_IMPLEMENT_ON_CLEAR_PLAN` enabled branch, before the `sleep 3`.
1. Run the classifier on `${CODEX_OUTPUT_FILE}`. This costs no API call.
2. Fetch the pipeline login (`gh api user --jq .login`) only when protected paths exist and the flag is on. That is at most one extra call.
3. Use the `CURRENT_ISSUE_JSON` that the step already fetched live as the issue metadata, written to a temp file. It already has `number`, `user`, `author_association` and `body`, so no new issue read is needed.
4. On hold:
   - log `AI_PHASE_GATE_V1 phase=plan gate=auto_approve reason=<r> outcome=defer issue=<n> protected_paths=<csv> missing_paths=<csv>`;
   - append the same detail to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`;
   - leave `auto_approved=false`, so the existing "Plan awaiting approval" Telegram alert fires;
   - `exit 0`.
5. If the helper file is missing: hold with `reason=gate_helper_missing` (fail closed).

`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
- New `_automation_path_plan_auto_approve_gate <issue_num> <issue_details_json> <comments_json>`:
  - finds the newest comment whose first line is `Implementation Plan` and whose author (lowercased) equals `NOOP_CAP_TRUSTED_LOGIN`;
  - builds the issue metadata from the cache (`number`, `body`, `author_login` lowercased, `author_association`);
  - runs the guard CLI from `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR:-scripts}`;
  - returns 0 for allow and 1 for hold, and logs `AI_PHASE_GATE_V1 phase=orchestrate_poll gate=auto_approve reason=… outcome=defer issue=… protected_paths=…`;
  - holds (fail closed) when there is no plan comment, the comments are unavailable, the pipeline login is empty, or the helper is missing.
- Managed arm: call the gate after the staged-support latch check, reusing `_managed_staged_support_comments`. That list already comes from `_staged_support_comments_for_guard`, which falls back to a paginated read when the cache is incomplete. On hold: `echo "STALL_SKIP issue=… reason=automation_path_plan_auto_approval_hold phase=… action=none"; return 1`. This is the same no-increment pattern the latch skip uses.
- Standalone arm: before posting, take `comments_json` from `_candidate_details_json` and pass it through `_staged_support_comments_for_guard`, then run the same gate. On hold: STALL_SKIP, `took_action` stays `"false"`, and `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT` is not set.
- `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql`: add `author { login }` and `authorAssociation` to the fragment, mapped to `author_login` and `author_association`. Keep `number` in t
